comment: Deliberate deviation: recursion through a := right-hand side is NOT a tail call, so it consumes call depth and trips the DEFAULT_MAX_CALL_DEPTH=100 cap (docs/spec.md 4.6). jsonata-js answers 0 because it has no depth cap at all — the same cap already rejects the sibling non-tail shapes `$f($n-1)+1` and `($x := $f($n-1); $x)`, which jsonata-js also runs to completion. Before jsntrs-p0v.15 this one shape alone was trampolined.
